data.source: NASA PDS, Mars 2020 MEDA calibrated TIRS + PS, hourly means (LTST)

method.task: Issued at the end of a sol; forecasts every hour of the next 1-7 sols.
method.baseline: Mean of the same hour over the previous 7 sols.
method.models: For every lead (1-7 sols): a ridge model and a LightGBM model correct the baseline; their corrections are blended with weights that may shrink towards the baseline.
method.uncertainty: Split-conformal: empirical out-of-sample errors by lead and hour (paired air/ground for joint probabilities).
method.validation: Walk-forward, refit every 60 sols on past data only; choices made on sols 200-519, test on sols 520-700.

probability.note: Daylight test hours only. Probabilities use errors from the selection sols, so the test sols are scored out of sample.
